description: Source code for the 'nameref' package implementing a filter to update Kubernetes resource name references, including methods for filtering, setting references, and handling resource identity and namespace considerations.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A filter to update name references in Kubernetes resources, with methods for filtering nodes and setting reference values.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Constructor for the Filter class.

methods.name: Filter.Filter
methods.description: Applies the filter to a list of YAML nodes.

methods.name: Filter.run
methods.description: Executes the filtering logic on a single YAML node, updating references.

methods.name: Filter.set
methods.description: Sets the reference value in a YAML node, handling scalar, mapping, and sequence nodes.

methods.name: Filter.setMapping
methods.description: Updates the 'name' and 'namespace' fields in a mapping node based on referral.

methods.name: Filter.filterMapCandidatesByNamespace
methods.description: Filters referral candidates based on namespace.

methods.name: Filter.setScalar
methods.description: Updates a scalar node with a referral's name.

methods.name: Filter.recordTheReferral
methods.description: Records a referral resource as being referred by the referrer.

methods.name: Filter.getRoleRefGvk
methods.description: Retrieves the GroupVersionKind from a roleRef resource.

methods.name: Filter.doSieve
methods.description: Filters a list of resources based on a sieve function.

methods.name: Filter.acceptAll
methods.description: Accepts all resources.

methods.name: Filter.previousNameMatches
methods.description: Sieve function to match resources with a previous name.

methods.name: Filter.previousIdSelectedByGvk
methods.description: Sieve function to match resources with previous IDs matching a GVK.

methods.name: Filter.roleRefFilter
methods.description: Sieve function to filter roleRef resources based on GVK.

methods.name: Filter.prefixSuffixEquals
methods.description: Sieve function to match resources with prefix/suffix.

methods.name: Filter.sameCurrentNamespaceAsReferrer
methods.description: Sieve function to match resources in the same namespace as the referrer.

methods.name: Filter.selectReferral
methods.description: Selects the best referral resource from candidates.

methods.name: Filter.failureDetails
methods.description: Generates a detailed message for referral selection failures.

methods.name: Filter.allNamesAreTheSame
methods.description: Checks if all resources have the same name.

methods.name: Filter.allNamesAndNamespacesAreTheSame
methods.description: Checks if all resources have the same name and namespace.

methods.name: Filter.getIds
methods.description: Returns a string of resource IDs.

methods.name: Filter.checkEqual
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal, returning an error if not.

methods.name: Filter.confirmNodeMatchesReferrer
methods.description: Verifies that a node's metadata matches the referrer's GVK, name, and namespace.
